name: Combined Merit Scholarship
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance**

- For Degree Courses: ₹300/- per month.
- For Master Degree Courses: ₹500/- per month.
- The scheme provides 200 scholarships for degree students (three years duration) and 100 scholarships for master degree students (two years duration).

**Selection:** Based on merit and budget allocation.
**Coverage:** Students pursuing general degree and master degree courses in Art
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be pursuing general degree or master's degree courses in Arts, Science, or Commerce discipline in any recognized institution. - The applicant must be domiciled in Assam (Permanent Resident Certificate document mandatory). - The applicant must have obtained minimum 60% marks in Higher Secondary examination for those applying for Combined Merit Degree Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must have obtained minimum 60% marks in General Degree (Three Year Degree Course) examination for those applying for Combined Merit Master Degree Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must possess relevant qualification from any recognized institution. - The applicant must have a valid bank account in their name (preferably in State Bank of India).
